v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Tibi soli peccávi, * Dómine, miserére mei.
text.en: Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
text.en: Turn thee again, O Lord, * and be gracious unto thy servants.
O God, * thou hast multiplied thy mercy.

text.la: Fortitúdo mea * et laus mea Dóminus: et factus est mihi in salútem.
text.en: The Lord is my strength * and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum qui sanat contrítos corde, et álligat contritiónes eórum.
text.en: Praise the Lord * who healeth the broken of heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Tu es qui ventúrus es, * Dómine, quem exspectámus, ut salvum fácias pópulum tuum.
text.en: O Lord, Thou art He That should come, * for Whom we look, that Thou shouldest save thy people.

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Melchíadem Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Melchiades thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.

office.title: Feria V infra Hebd II Adventus
